query:
SELECT 
  o.id as officeId,
  o.slug,
  o.officeName,
  s.id as serviceId,
  s.serviceName,
  s.price
FROM sanad_offices o
JOIN sanad_office_services s ON o.id = s.officeId
WHERE o.slug = 'test-office-filters-1766758228421'
LIMIT 1
